headline: 1,711 real public alerts from 8 feeds (snapshot 2026-11-08): 0 record that AI or machine translation was involved, and none records who approved them. The only approver-like fields are one vendor's login names (UserName), in 17 US alerts.

rows.source: Canada: Environment and Climate Change Canada, Meteorological Service of Canada; Canada: Ministère de la Sécurité publique du Québec [en, fr]

note: The gate was also run over the 1000 US alerts using the rules that need no issuer context (R0, R2, R6, R10): it would hold 5 (R2: 2, R10: 3). Scheduled US EAS tests sent as status Actual are exempt; that exemption was added after a first run flagged them. UAE: no CAP feed is listed on the WMO Register of Alerting Authorities (record dated 2013).
